# Glove Garage

> Professional baseball and softball glove restoration, relacing, deep cleaning, and vintage glove repair serving Northeast Arkansas (NEA), the Memphis metro area, and nationwide via a secure mail-in service.

## Core Services & Pricing

- [Glove Spa](https://glovegarage.com/services) ($25) - Deep cleaning, premium leather conditioning, and component tightening.
- [Partial Relace](https://glovegarage.com/services) ($35) - Replacement of broken web or finger laces using premium leather.
- [Full Glove Overhaul](https://glovegarage.com/services) ($80) - Complete lace replacement, deep conditioning, and full pocket reshaping.
- [Catcher / First Base Mitt Overhaul](https://glovegarage.com/services) ($110) - Heavy-duty specialized lacing for high-impact position gloves.
- [Vintage Restoration](https://glovegarage.com/services) ($150) - Complete historical restoration for decades-old gloves requiring specialized leather care.

## Local & Mail-In Operations

- **Primary Service Regions:** Northeast Arkansas (NEA) and the Memphis Metropolitan Area.
- **Local Communities Served:** Bay (AR), Jonesboro (AR), Craighead County (AR), Greene County (AR), Memphis (TN), Shelby County (TN).
- **Local Drop-Offs:** Available by appointment. Contact via phone at +18708977793 or email at glovegaragear@gmail.com.
- **Nationwide Mail-In:** Customers from anywhere in the United States can mail their gloves securely via UPS, FedEx, or USPS. Typical turnaround time is 7-10 business days from receipt.
